title: 小五：书桌上的分类牌
instruction: 阅读短文，为每一空选择最合适的一项。每空独立选择，不设每项只能用一次。
source_notice: 结构参照已核教辅中的完整例题：一篇、每空3个独立候选；六空例含多词候选，八空例为单词候选。原书标注2022普通期末卷来源，但原校卷及原整节范围未认证，原参考键有歧义，不当gold。本稿完整原创，逐候选回填为作者自审；独立教研、学生难度、商用和生产未验证。
passage: It is Friday afternoon. We are (1) ____ our teacher with a book sale. Sam and I (2) ____ the books to three tables. The story table is (3) ____ the window. I can stand beside the table and see the playground outside. Each table has a large sign. A girl cannot find the dog story she wants. She asks me to help her (4) ____ it. I show her the sign and take her to the right table. Soon there is a (5) ____ line of children. It goes from the table to the door! The girl says, “My little brother loves dogs.” She buys a book for (6) ____ little brother.
